messages:
andre_cs: Quick update 1 OrbitHealthX started an APAC pilot and immediately hit per-minute throttles. They asked for a short CIDR exception + per-route burst to validate throughput.

selena_acct: Renewal risk flagged if pilot stalls. They asked for a 14-day staging window; propose burst=500 rps on /v1/chat from their staging CIDR.

andre_cs: @nish_net can you add their staging CIDRs 203.0.120.0/28 and 198.51.106.0/29 to an allowlist? They also want header match X-Domain:ohx-staging. mTLS follow-up.

nish_net: Can do. Plan: ipset entries + temporary rate window + header allow. Recommend auto-revoke TTL=14d and global_soft=700 to allow short spikes. Any per-route caps?

mika_sre: Tagging SRE for a quick risk/capacity check. I'll run noisy-neighbor scan and attach a small-model fallback if needed. ETA ~35m.

runbook-bot: Preflight: APAC health clear. Recommend KV cache prewarm for orbithealthx prefix. Suggested p95 alert = 1500ms.

nish_net: Draft change snippet:

```
# OrbitHealthX temp allowlist + rate window (auto-revoke 14d)
ipset add orbithealthx_203 203.0.120.0/28
ipset add orbithealthx_198 198.51.106.0/29
route /v1/chat burst=500 per_route_soft=500 global_soft=700 headers.allow=X-Domain:ohx-staging
# tag: orbithealthx-pilot-3141592653
```

nish_net: Opening JIRA INF-7142. Rollback scheduled for 2026-04-30 (auto-revoke webhook).

andre_cs: Capture telemetry: they reported 250-380ms median in us-west but 900-1400ms p95 in ap-southeast during spikes. They asked if token-level region pin to ap-southeast-1 is possible.

mika_sre: Token-level pinning is possible. It reduces RTT but increases egress/cost. I'll compute a cost delta and send to @selena_acct; we'll enable pin only after customer agreement.

selena_acct: Please share cost delta before pinning. Also note renewal tracker: "Pilot latency in APAC impacting conversion; temporary concession granted."

andre_cs: Scheduling a 45m enablement + runbook session Friday to validate prompts and monitor quality under load. We'll capture any hallucination or regression signals correlated with higher qps.

nish_net: Change queued pending SRE signoff (INF-7142). Adding webhook to auto-revoke ipset after TTL.

mika_sre: Change applied to staging; smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in ~10m. Alerts set: p95 > 1600ms triggers rollback + small-model fallback. Will also prewarm KV cache before flip.

andre_cs: :thumbsup: ping me when live so i can notify OrbitHealthX and schedule the Friday session. Logging customer note: "APAC pilot latency blocking conversion".

nish_net: Live. CIDRs added, rate window active, header enforcement in place. Watchlist created: orbithealthx-3141592653.

andre_cs: We'll review telemetry after 24h and capture sentiment + any quality regressions.

selena_acct: I'll prepare usage + cost summary for day 10 and follow up on renewal outreach.

andre_cs: Thanks team.
